from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    Column,
    DateTime,
    Float,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship

Base = declarative_base()


class Users(Base):
    """People"""
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, nullable=True)
    email = Column(Text, primary_key=False, nullable=False)
    password = Column(Text, primary_key=False, nullable=True)


class Orders(Base):
    """Declarative model for table 'orders'."""
    __tablename__ = "orders"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, nullable=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"), primary_key=False, nullable=True)
    total = Column(Numeric, primary_key=False, nullable=True)
    user = relationship("Users", foreign_keys=[user_id])


class Items(Base):
    """Declarative model for table 'items'."""
    __tablename__ = "items"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, nullable=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("orders.id"), primary_key=False, nullable=True)
    order = relationship("Orders", foreign_keys=[order_id])

files.proj_default/main.py:
"""
Query-Builder Starter Backend API.
"""

from fastapi import FastAPI
from query_builder import SQLiteConnector, create_query_builder_router

app = FastAPI(title="Query-Builder Starter API")

# Auto-seed starter tables on launch if using SQLite
import sqlite3
_conn = sqlite3.connect("starter.db")
_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, email TEXT NOT NULL, full_name TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL);")
_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), total_amount REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL);")
if _conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users;").fetchone()[0] == 0:
    _conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (id, email, full_name, created_at) VALUES (1, 'alice@example.com', 'Alice Smith', '2026-01-01');")
    _conn.execute("INSERT INTO orders (id, user_id, total_amount, status) VALUES (1, 1, 99.50, 'COMPLETED');")
    _conn.commit()
_conn.close()

connector = SQLiteConnector(database="starter.db")
router = create_query_builder_router(connector=connector, prefix="/api")
app.include_router(router)

@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "healthy"}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=8000)

"""
Query-Builder Minimal Starter.
"""

import json
from query_builder import QueryCompiler, validate_sql_ast

with open("spec.json", "r") as f:
    spec = json.load(f)
with open("schema.json", "r") as f:
    schema = json.load(f)

compiler = QueryCompiler(spec, schema=schema, dialect="snowflake")
sql, params, count_sql, count_params = compiler.compile()

print("Compiled SQL:/n", sql)
print("Params:", params)
print("AST Validation:", validate_sql_ast(sql))
